findings.title: Default-strategy deployment still does not enable rolling-updates despite documented operator requirement
findings.body: createInitialDeployment returns immediately when updateStrategy is null without enabling the rolling-updates feature, and both parameterized tests then expect that deployment to become ready. This contradicts docs/guides/operator/advanced-configuration.adoc, which states that while rolling-updates is in preview the feature must be enabled or the Operator will fail. Either the null/default path will fail in the operator (making these parameterized cases invalid/failing) or the documentation overstates the requirement for deployments without an explicit update strategy; the PR leaves the two inconsistent and does not test the documented failure/default behavior.

findings.title: Feature-disabled exit code 4 is not verified and check subcommand gating is untested
findings.body: The new testFeatureNotEnabled test only launches the metadata subcommand and only asserts the error message. It does not assert the newly introduced CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED exit code (4), which is the script-facing contract documented in update-compatibility.adoc, and it does not exercise the separate gating branch added to UpdateCompatibilityCheck. A regression that prints the message but exits with 0, or that fails to gate the check subcommand, would therefore pass the test suite.
